summary: TeamMapper is a self-hosted knowledge management tool for creating and sharing mindmaps. It provides a shared workspace where teams can collaborate on visual brainstorming and structuring sessions in real time.
goodFor: It suits teams looking for a dedicated, locally hosted tool for collaborative visual mapping without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: The codebase has a relatively low maintenance health score with slowing update activity, which might present risks for long-term support and bug fixes.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
